## Source order (for planning)

Per `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md`, conflicts resolve as:

1. `AI_DOCS.md`  
2. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\combat\AXEL_combat_implementation.md`  
3. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\combat\AXEL_combat_design.md`  
4. `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\references\AXEL_notes.md`  
5. Prototype HTML/CSS, then exports  

If you follow a lower-priority source on purpose, that choice and reason belong in the changelog.

---

## (1) Constraints list (combat UI–relevant)

**Hierarchy and workflow**

- Treat **plans as design truth** and **code as behavior truth**; reconcile before UI implies mechanic changes (`AI_DOCS.md` §8).
- **Do not blur layers**: narrative/prototype vs combat; combat orchestration stays anchored on `combat_root.gd` (`AI_DOCS.md` §4–§5).
- Substantive work: **intent deduction + canon alignment** before implementation; **hard conflict gate**: if a UI request implies breaking invariants, stop and offer 2–4 options (`AI_DOCS.md` §10, `axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`).

**Combat invariants (UI must not contradict or “teach” the wrong rules)**

- **5×5 grid**, **line wins** (row/column runs of 3+, no cluster flood-fill), **wild only from exactly-3 lines** (middle cell), **multiplier tied to cascade/drop progression**, **`combat_root.gd`** as spin → resolve → cascade → power hub (`AI_DOCS.md` §5; echoed in implementation).
- **Fixed premium alias map**: `cigarette` → Storm, `booze`/`alcohol` → Star, `bloody hand` → Love — UI copy and labels should stay consistent with this (`AI_DOCS.md` §5; design §4, §7).
- **Terminology lock**: “Regular Free Spins” = **Trinity Run**; “SUPER Free Spins” = the later bonus; bare **“Free Spins”** is ambiguous — clarify before labeling HUD/modes (`AI_DOCS.md` §5; `AXEL_notes.md` §13).

**Architecture / code shape affecting UI**

- **Logic vs rendering**: grid state must resolve without visuals; renderer listens to grid signals — UI should not bake rules into display-only code that the grid machine does not enforce (`AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §2.3, §10).
- **Determinism**: RNG is centralized/seeded; avoid UI-side randomness that affects outcomes (`AI_DOCS.md` §8; implementation §0, §1 rule of thumb).
- **RunState**: keep small; **do not persist renderer state** in run saves (`AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §11).

**Style and tone (UI/FX)**

- **Palette**: black + blood red (`#ff0000`) + dark blood (`#4a0000`); **CRT / scanline / glitch / shake core identity**; **VT323** centered (Space Mono secondary when needed); mood: **dread, guilt, memory corruption**; **big wins unsettling/intrusive**, not purely celebratory (`AI_DOCS.md` §6; design §1, §7; implementation §10 FX list).
- **Readability exception**: editor collision colors are a documented palette exception — not a license to abandon combat UI palette at runtime (`AI_DOCS.md` §8).

**Planned HUD surface (implementation checklist)**

- Base HUD: goal + progress, spin budget, multiplier, stake, **active princess portrait**, **Trinity meter (3 sections)**; Free Spins HUD: chosen princess, spins left, carry multiplier, cap/progress (`AXEL_combat_implementation.md` §10).
- Design: **premium trio = same power channels** in UI and docs; **grid clear** as the “clean” beat; **Abstinence** / lucid path is narratively load-bearing (affects how you message help vs restraint) (`AXEL_combat_design.md` §7).

**Symbol art policy (grid vs intro)**

- **Grid**: `res://combat/art/grid_symbols/*.png` (import size cap). **Power intro**: `res://combat/art/placeholders/*.png` via `SymbolDef.texture_for_power_intro()` / `CombatRoot` (`AXEL_notes.md` §12).

**Scope locations**

- Changes under `AXEL/axel_project/plans/*`, `combat/*`, `scenes/*`, `scripts/*`, etc. fall under this doc set (`AI_DOCS.md` §2).

---

## (2) Conflict risks for requested combat UI changes

(Framed generically; any specific mock would be checked against the bullets above.)

| Risk area | Why it conflicts or complicates |
|-----------|-----------------------------------|
| **Labels and modes** | Using vague **“Free Spins”** for Trinity vs SUPER mis-teaches rules and breaks terminology lock; may disagree with MP100-facing design for “Trinity” vs bonus naming. |
| **Princess / premium presentation** | Showing **upcoming rotation** by default contradicts design recommendation (**only active princess**); teaching three “separate” powers without alias mapping breaks §7 equivalence. |
| **Celebratory UX** | Heavy confetti/“jackpot” tone fights **unsettling win** and guilt/memory identity. |
| **Palette / typography** | Off-palette UI or off-canon fonts weakens **black/red CRT** identity (exceptions need explicit noting). |
| **Coupling UI to mechanics** | Driving spin resolution, RNG, or goals from Control nodes instead of **`combat_root` + grid signals** risks breaking determinism and the logic/render split. |
| **Persisting UI in save data** | Storing tween/layout/timer state in **RunState** violates implementation guardrail. |
| **Implying wrong rules** | UI that suggests **cluster wins**, **per-line multiplier steps**, or **wilds from 4/5 lines** contradicts stated invariants. |
| **Symbol assets** | Replacing textures without **dual grid + power-intro** paths breaks performance/clarity policy. |
| **Item roster naming** | New UI surfaces for items that invent IDs outside **`AXEL_COMBAT_ITEM_CATALOG_PLAN.md`** / tier conventions can drift catalog canon (`AI_DOCS.md` §5 item catalog). |

---

## (3) Files to update for changelog / governance compliance

**Always (when the request is actually implemented, substantive AXEL work)**

- `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md` — append an entry (`AI_DOCS.md` §9; `axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`).

**When you intentionally override hierarchy or resolve doc conflicts**

- Same changelog entry should **record the resolution and reason** (`AI_DOCS.md` §3, §9).

**When you add or change a reusable agent/workflow/pipeline** (e.g. new UI review step codified for agents)

- `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_DOCS.md`  
- `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\.cursor\rules\axel-ai-docs-governance.mdc`  
- `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\plans\core\AI_CHANGELOG.md`  
(all together — `AI_DOCS.md` §9, §11; governance §8)

**Planning-only doc alignment (not “changelog compliance,” but keeps canon consistent)**

- If UI plans **change player-visible rules or terminology**, update the **higher-priority combat docs** first — typically `AXEL_combat_implementation.md` and/or `AXEL_combat_design.md`, and `AXEL_notes.md` if terminology or asset policy shifts — so they do not contradict `AI_DOCS.md` §5.

**QA artifacts (not changelog, but governance-adjacent after substantive edits)**

- Agents should **ask** about running simulated QA; rubric/run log paths are in `AI_DOCS.md` §11–12 (optional follow-up, not a mandatory file edit for every UI tweak).
